snippet.title: Fenix 3D Platformer - Tech Demo #1 - With Commentary
snippet.description:
Hey guys!  Here is my first tech demo for my 3D platformer called Fenix!  I poured a couple hundred hours into this personal project, with over 15 unique C# scripts and over 1000 lines of code written!  Additionally, over 25 low poly style graphical assets were downloaded for free from the Unity store which really helped bring this project to life!  For this reason, the creators of these assets will get recognition in the credits of any final release version of my game project.  And with that, I hope you enjoy the platforming presentation!   Thank you. 

Photosensitive Warning: Read Before Playing!
Certain conditions may induce previously undetected epileptic symptoms even in persons who have no history of prior seizures or epilepsy. If you, or anyone in your family, have an epileptic condition, consult your physician prior to playing.
